\documentclass[border=2pt]{standalone}
\usepackage{pgfplots}
\pgfplotsset{compat=1.18}
\begin{document}
\begin{tikzpicture}
  \begin{axis}[width=9cm,height=6cm,axis lines=middle,
    xmin=0,xmax=6,ymin=0,ymax=6,enlargelimits=false,
    xtick distance=2,ytick distance=2,minor tick num=1,
    grid=both,grid style={gray!35},xlabel=$x$,ylabel=$y$]
    \addplot[blue,thick,domain=0:6,samples=80] {sqrt(x)};
  \end{axis}
\end{tikzpicture}
\end{document}
